kpis.name: Reduction in private car dependency
kpis.target_text: Private car modal share; 35 % modal shift in target areas
kpis.ga_baseline: Private car modal share (national): Lithuania 91.7 %, Latvia 83.7 %
kpis.primary_data: Trip modal split (household / PUMH user surveys), PT ridership and car flows at the hubs before vs after.

charts.title: Passenger cars per 1,000 inhabitants

series.label: Latvia
series.source: Official Statistics Portal of Latvia (data.stat.gov.lv) TRC010

charts.desc: Motorisation rate - the most granular public proxy of car dependency. Lithuanian series start in 2014 (register methodology break 2013/2014).

charts.title: Passenger cars - share of inland passenger-km
charts.desc: GA baseline for this KPI is the national private-car modal share (Lithuania 91.7 %, Latvia 83.7 %). National level only: excludes walking, cycling and urban PT.

kpis.name: Decrease in mobility-related CO2 emissions
kpis.ga_baseline: Transport share of national GHG: Lithuania ~25 % (falling), Latvia ~25 %
kpis.primary_data: Pilot-area traffic volumes, vehicle classes and speeds (AI cameras / S7 counters) + emission factors.

charts.title: GHG emissions from road transport (index 2015 = 100)
charts.desc: Indexed so that countries of very different size share one axis. Absolute values (Mt CO2e) shown in the table view.

charts.title: GHG emissions from road transport
charts.desc: Fuel combustion in road transport, national inventory.

charts.title: Transport share of total national GHG emissions
charts.desc: Matches the GA baseline wording ("transport share of national GHGs ~25 %").

kpis.name: Increase in multimodal transport efficiency
kpis.ga_baseline: EU Urban Mobility Scorecard 2024 & pilot diagnostics (TBD)
kpis.primary_data: Door-to-door travel and transfer times, punctuality, connections at PUMHs, PT demand.

charts.title: Bus passengers per bus-km on regular routes
charts.desc: Derived productivity proxy: passengers carried divided by vehicle-km run by buses and trolleybuses on regular routes (registered in the municipality). Rising = more efficient use of the PT supply.

charts.title: Bus & trolleybus passengers per vehicle-km - Vilnius city (comparison)
charts.desc: Same indicator for the core city network - a comparison series for difference-in-differences against the pilot district.

charts.title: Bus vehicle-km on regular routes - Vilnius district
charts.desc: PT supply offered by carriers registered in Vilnius District (suburban regular routes).

charts.title: Rīgas satiksme public transport boardings (e-ticket validations)

series.label: Riga city (Rīgas satiksme network)
series.note: Earlier months (2018-05/06, 2020-01) published only partly and are excluded; not all passengers validate.

charts.desc: Monthly demand on the Riga municipal PT network - the most frequent public series for the Riga pilot.

charts.title: Passengers carried by tram and trolleybus - Riga

series.label: Riga City
series.source: Official Statistics Portal of Latvia (data.stat.gov.lv) TPA010

kpis.name: Reduction in VRU-related accident risks
kpis.ga_baseline: VRU deaths per million: Lithuania 45-65, Latvia 59
kpis.primary_data: Accident records with location (S10), VRU exposure counts and conflict / near-miss detection from AI cameras.

charts.title: Road casualties in Vilnius District Municipality
charts.desc: Pilot-municipality level, all road users (public data are not split by VRU at municipal level). VRU split requires the S10 accident-level dataset (data.gov.lt/datasets/3164) - to be downloaded locally.

charts.title: Injury road accidents per month - Vilnius district
charts.desc: Monthly series: useful for before/after comparison around PUMH opening dates (use 12-month means to remove seasonality).

charts.title: Vulnerable road users killed - Lithuania
charts.desc: National VRU fatalities by road-user type.

charts.title: Road deaths per million inhabitants
charts.desc: GA baseline reference ("deaths per million": Lithuania 45-65, Latvia 59).

charts.title: Pedestrians killed in road accidents
Deaths in road accidents - Riga city

kpis.name: Increase in citizen participation in planning
kpis.ga_baseline: < 20 % of peri-urban residents participate in planning
kpis.primary_data: Unique participants vs target population; Citizen-Voice App, VR/AR workshop and consultation registers.

kpis.name: Decrease in last-mile logistics emissions
kpis.primary_data: Delivery km, vehicle type, fuel/energy and load from logistics operators; emissions model.

charts.title: GHG from light-duty trucks (vans) - index 2015 = 100
charts.desc: Light-duty vehicles do most urban last-mile deliveries; this is the closest public emissions proxy. National level only.

charts.title: Road share of inland freight (tonne-km)
charts.desc: Context indicator for freight modal structure.

kpis.name: Reduction in logistics packaging waste
kpis.primary_data: Packaging mass by material before vs after bioPLU deployment; operator records, LCA.

kpis.name: Increase in logistics efficiency
kpis.primary_data: Delivery delays, time and cost per delivery from operators.

charts.title: Road share of inland freight (tonne-km)
charts.desc: Context only - logistics efficiency (delays, cost per delivery) must come from logistics operators in the pilot.

kpis.name: Reduction in peri-urban congestion
kpis.primary_data: Travel time, average speed, queue length and flows on the same corridors before vs after (S7 counters, cameras, navigation data).

kpis.name: Reduction in annual economic losses from congestion
kpis.primary_data: Vehicle-hours of delay x value of time; requires congestion KPI 9 plus an economic model.

kpis.name: Policy compliance process acceleration
kpis.primary_data: Submission and decision dates of the relevant permit / planning procedures from municipal registers.

kpis.name: Reduction in peri-urban transport GHG emissions
kpis.primary_data: Pilot-territory traffic volumes, VKT and fleet mix; emissions model with defined boundary (avoid double counting with KPI 2).

charts.title: Registered passenger cars - peri-urban vs core (index 2021 = 100)

series.label: Pierīga peri-urban municipalities (8, aggregated)
series.source: Official Statistics Portal of Latvia (data.stat.gov.lv) TRC011

series.label: Riga City
series.source: Official Statistics Portal of Latvia (data.stat.gov.lv) TRC011

charts.desc: Activity driver for peri-urban transport emissions: the car fleet grows much faster in the peri-urban ring than in the core cities. Pierīga = Ādaži, Ķekava, Mārupe, Olaine, Ropaži, Salaspils, Saulkrasti, Sigulda; shown from 2021 only (administrative-territorial reform changed borders in 2021).

charts.title: Registered passenger cars - Vilnius District Municipality
GHG from passenger cars (national) - index 2015 = 100
charts.desc: National car-emission trend; a pilot-area value requires the emissions model (traffic counts x fleet mix x emission factors).

kpis.name: Reduction in noise pollution
kpis.primary_data: Lden / Lnight measurements near the hubs and corridors.

charts.title: Population reporting noise from neighbours or the street
charts.desc: Survey-based national indicator (EU-SILC). Riga strategic noise maps (2018, 2021; Lden/Lnight GIS layers) are stored in Ryga/_zaliavos for a spatial baseline around the hubs.

kpis.name: Increase in sustainable transport adoption
kpis.primary_data: Mode shares of trips, PT boardings at hub stops, pedestrian / cyclist counts.

charts.title: Length of cycle paths
charts.desc: Supply-side enabler of sustainable trips. Vilnius district network grew from 10 km (2020) to 43 km (2025).

charts.title: Passengers on regular bus routes
charts.desc: Passengers carried by carriers registered in Vilnius District on regular (mainly suburban) routes.

charts.title: Riga municipal PT boardings - 12-month rolling total
charts.desc: Rolling sum removes seasonality - best line for judging trend changes after hub openings.

charts.title: Bus, coach and train - share of inland passenger-km

kpis.name: Reduction in pollution's human-health effect
kpis.primary_data: Population exposure (air + noise) in the pilot area and an exposure-response model.

charts.title: Premature deaths attributable to PM2.5 exposure
charts.desc: EEA health-impact estimate, all sources of PM2.5 (not transport only). National level.

charts.title: Deaths from respiratory diseases (ICD-10 J)
charts.desc: Context outcome - strongly influenced by non-transport factors (e.g. COVID-19 in 2020-2021).

kpis.name: Increase in participatory governance efficiency
kpis.ga_baseline: Fragmented, low engagement; input mechanisms inconsistent or absent
kpis.primary_data: Share of engaged citizens, time to process proposals, number of co-design cycles (Citizen-Voice / VR-AR logs).
